body:
On a Strategy run, the run bar shows both **End** and **Stop**. They do the same thing: each ends the run and saves its conversation. The only difference is a hidden label on the past run ("planned" or "stopped"), so a user can't tell them apart and gains nothing from choosing.

**Change:** the run bar shows one button, **End**, which ends the open run. **Stop** is removed.

The Design page uses the same planning panel and has the same pair, so it gets the same single button.

For the agent: today `POST .../end` gives outcome `planned` and `.../stop` gives `stopped`; otherwise `tasks::strategy.change_run` treats them alike. Keep one route and one outcome, keep past runs saved as `stopped` readable, and update Spec 15 (strategy and design run routes) and the run-bar test.
title: planning panel: one End button
